description: This file defines an interface for storage management within the WPEFramework. It declares the IStorageManager interface with methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage associated with applications, along with relevant parameters and expected behaviors.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: An interface for managing application storage, supporting creation, retrieval, deletion, and clearing of storage data.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a given application ID with specified size, returning the storage path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage location and size details for a specific application ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a specific application ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a given application ID, also potentially clearing device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all application storage data except for exempted app IDs, based on provided exemption list.
